doc.CNI.label: National ID card
doc.CNI.text: Your country’s national ID card, still valid.
doc.PASSPORT.label: Passport
doc.PASSPORT.text: A passport from any country, still valid (photo page).
doc.DRIVING_LICENSE.label: Driving licence
doc.RESIDENT_CARD.label: Resident or consular card
doc.RESIDENT_CARD.text: Resident card, residence permit or consular card, still valid.
reject.NAME_MISMATCH: Name differs from the one on the document
reject.SELFIE_MISMATCH: Selfie does not match the document
reject.INCOMPLETE: Incomplete document (corners or details cut off)
cam.unsupported: Your browser cannot use the camera. Upload a photo instead.
cam.denied: Camera access was denied. Allow it from the browser’s address bar, or upload a photo.
cam.notFound: No camera found on this computer. Upload a photo taken with your phone.
cam.busy: The camera is already in use by another app. Close it and try again, or upload a photo.
cam.failed: Could not open the camera. Upload a photo instead.
cam.selfieHint: Put your face in the oval and hold the document next to it, clearly readable.
cam.docHint: Put the document in the frame, well lit and without glare.
tip.light.title: Good lighting
tip.light.text: Avoid dark areas and shadows cast by your phone.
tip.glare.title: No glare or flash
tip.glare.text: Tilt the card slightly if the light causes glare.
tip.corners.title: 4 corners visible
tip.corners.text: The whole document must fit in the frame, with no edge cut off.
tip.lens.title: Look at the lens
tip.lens.text: Face forward, well lit, neutral expression.
tip.face.title: Face uncovered
tip.face.text: Remove cap, hat, mask and tinted glasses.
tip.idBeside.title: Document next to your face
tip.idBeside.text: Without hiding your photo or names with your fingers.
privacy.title: Your documents stay confidential
privacy.text: They are kept in a private space, viewed only by the Dilchap verification team, never shown to buyers, and deleted {{days}} days after the decision.
intro.title: Verify your identity
intro.text: Required to turn on the “Verified account” or “Certified seller” badge on your profile and listings.
intro.badges.title: Access to Dilchap badges
intro.badges.text: Turn on the “Verified account” badge (or “Certified seller” with a good track record) by subscription.
intro.shop.title: Official shop
intro.shop.text: Identity verification is required to open an official shop.
intro.trust.title: More trust at meet-ups
intro.trust.text: Buyers know your identity was checked before meeting you.
doc.badgesText: Once the Dilchap team has verified your document, turn on the “Verified account” or “Certified seller” badge by subscription.
doc.filter.title: “Verified sellers” filter
doc.filter.text: With an active badge, your listings stay visible to buyers who filter.
doc.meetup.title: Meet-ups with confidence
doc.meetup.text: Buyers know who they are dealing with.
doc.title: Which document would you like to use?
doc.text: The original, still valid and in good condition (photocopies and screenshots are refused).
shot.frontCni: Take a photo of the front of your ID card
shot.front: Take a photo of the front of your document
shot.back: Take a photo of the back
shot.selfie: Take a selfie holding your document
shot.frontPassportText: The page with your photo, name and passport number.
shot.frontText: The side with your photo, name and document number.
shot.backText: The other side of the document, whole and clearly readable.
shot.selfieText: Hold the document next to your face, without hiding your features or the card’s details.
shot.tips: Tips to get it right first time
shot.toBack: Confirm and go to the back
photos.title: Photos of your {{doc}} and selfie
photos.text: Take the photos with your phone or upload them from your computer.
photos.frontHint: Side with your photo, name and number.
photos.selfieHint: Document held next to your face.
review.title: Check your details
review.text: Copy them exactly as they appear on your ID document.
review.consent: I certify that this information is accurate and I authorise Dilchap to verify my ID document so I can turn on a Dilchap badge. My photos will be deleted {{days}} days after the decision.
review.neverShown: Your documents are never shown to buyers.
pending.title: Application sent
pending.text: Your request is in the hands of the Dilchap verification team.
pending.answerText: Notification as soon as it is decided
pending.step1.title: Check by the team
pending.step1.text: We check that the document is genuine and matches your selfie.
pending.step2.title: Access to badges
pending.step2.text: You will be able to turn on the “Verified account” badge by subscription.
pending.step3.title: Photos deleted
pending.step3.text: Your ID photos are deleted {{days}} days after the decision.
pending.listingsOnline: Your listings stay online during the review.
rejected.title: Your verification could not be completed
rejected.text: It is often a blurry photo or a detail that differs from the document. You can start again right away.
rejected.tip1: Place the document on a dark surface, well lit, without flash.
rejected.tip2: Clean your phone’s lens before taking the photo.
rejected.tip3: Make sure all 4 corners of the document are visible and the text is readable.
validated.text: Your identity has been verified. You can now turn on the Verified account badge on your profile and listings.
validated.tick.title: Tick next to your name
validated.tick.text: On your profile, each of your listings and in messages.
validated.filter.title: Visible with the “Verified sellers” filter
validated.filter.text: Your listings show up for buyers who filter on it.
validated.trust.title: More trust
validated.trust.text: Buyers know your identity has been checked.
validated.deletion: Your ID photos are deleted {{days}} days after the decision.
